description: nano is a collaborative design canvas where designs are real HTML and CSS. People and AI agents can work on the same designs live in the browser, including temporary guest workspaces that can later be claimed by a signed-in user.
summary: nano.design exposes one hosted MCP server at https://nano.design/mcp, authenticated either by self-onboarding OAuth or by a short-lived guest bearer key minted from its guest-workspace flow.
